name: Founder to founder
description: Peer-to-peer, no seller framing. Trades something useful before asking for anything, because the only currency that works founder to founder is being genuinely helpful first.
audience: Founders and co-founders at companies roughly your stage, in an adjacent market rather than a competing one.

variants: {{firstName|Hi}} — building something in an adjacent space to {{company|yours}}. Always happy to swap notes with people a step ahead or a step behind. Connecting.
Hi {{firstName|there}} — fellow founder. We're solving a neighbouring problem to {{company|your company}} and I'd rather know you than not. No ask.
Thanks {{firstName|there}}. Honest question rather than a pitch: what's the hardest part of the business right now? Ours is that distribution is entirely manual and it doesn't scale.
Good to connect, {{firstName|there}}. What's currently breaking at {{company|your company}}? I'll trade you — ours is hiring faster than we can onboard.
{{firstName|Hi}} — if it's useful I'll send what we learned getting through the same wall. No strings, genuinely. Want it?
Offer stands, {{firstName|there}}: happy to write up what worked and what wasted six months for us. Say the word.
I'll stop filling your inbox, {{firstName|there}}. Good luck with {{company|the build}} — shout if a second opinion is ever useful.
Leaving it there, {{firstName|there}}. Rooting for {{company|you}} from a distance. Ping me any time.
